text:
Maya: Heads-up — Skyline QBR tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need a concise spend snapshot, top token drivers, onboarding status, and any renewal risks. Please post numbers + 1-line remediation options by EOD. @Eli @Jin

Eli: On it. I'll pull 30d token burn + a 30d projection. Any thresholds you want highlighted for finance?

Maya: Flag if MoM increase >20%, projected 30d spend > monthly commit, or any single route >40% of tokens. Also note embed-heavy routes and onboarding gaps that cause re-ingestion.

Ravi: Quick plan — run the usage query and paste top routes. Query I'll run: ```sql
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer = 'skyline' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
I'll post numbers in 10m.

Jin: I'll collect enablement notes + captured feedback — SSO/production mapping status and any docs they couldn't run. Will add recommended playbook steps.

Eli: Results (30d):
- total tokens: 7,050,000
- top routes: search-embeddings 3,920,000 (55.6%), chat-default 1,210,000 (17.2%), batch-ingest 860,000 (12.2%)
- projection (trend): 8,900,000 tokens next 30d -> estimated cost ~$7,200
- MoM change: +26%

Maya: +26% — exceeds 20% threshold. Mark renewal risk and request an enablement touchpoint pre-QBR. Also add finance note about commit overshoot.

Jin: Onboarding status: 6/8 integrations complete. Remaining: SSO and "prod dataset mapping". Current symptom: they keep re-ingesting historical messages until mapping is done which inflates tokens. Scheduled a runbook session for Thu 14:00 PT. Enablement doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/skyline (internal)

Sam: Customer feedback snippet from yesterday: "embeddings are noisy and we are sending full docs every query" — they asked for guidance on truncation and caching.

Eli: Suggested mitigations (quick):
1) Apply prefix/KV caching for search-embeddings route — expected savings ~30%
2) Enforce server-side token cap per request (2048) + deterministic truncation
3) Move large batch ingest to nightly dedupe (prevent duplicates)
If we apply 30% cache on embeddings, projected 30d drops to ~6.1M tokens -> est cost ~$5,000 (saves ~ $2.2k).

Ravi: I'll create a budget alert rule: monthly_commit_threshold = their commit * 0.9 -> send slack + email if forecast > threshold. Also tagging ticket with billing-guard.

Maya: Action items (final):
- Eli: share two forecast lines (current trend vs with cache) and attach to QBR packet (due EOD).
- Jin: Confirm SSO timeline and update enablement notes after Thu runbook.
- Ravi: Add budget-guard alert and create renewal-risk tag if commit exceeded.
- Everyone: add 1-line status to the QBR ticket: https://redwood.internal/qbr/skyline (internal).

qbr-bot: Dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/skyline?range=30d :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Ravi: :thumbsup:

Maya: Thank you — this is enough for the QBR one-pager. I'll draft the renewal note and invite the team.
